meta.name: Baywatch
meta.description:
Baywatch remastered and 24/7, starring David Hasselhoff and Pamela Anderson. A team of Los Angeles lifeguards save lives, deal with personal dramas, and fight crime.

Shows: Soul Survivor, Knife in the Heart, Bad Boyz, Dangerous Games, Stone Cold
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Tubi, The Roku Channel, Plex
